runs.text: Assignment happens in three stages, always in this order:

entries.text: The target is evaluated: the variable and, if any, its indices.
The right-hand expression is evaluated, with the values that exist
The result is stored in the target.

runs.text: works: the right side reads the old value and the result replaces the old one.
The classic example is swapping two values. A third variable is needed, because assigning loses what was there:

blocks.title: Swapping two variables

blocks.description: Three boxes a, b and auxiliar. a is 1 and b is 2. First auxiliar receives 1, then a receives 2 and finally b receives 1 from auxiliar.

caption.text: Swapping two values needs an auxiliary box that keeps the first one before it is overwritten.
